verdict.rationale: Elastic's docs explicitly describe running hybrid search combining full-text and vector search in a single request, recommending RRF fusion, with semantic_text simplifying embedding generation and indexing; this is corroborated by a runtime probe showing a real keyless index+search roundtrip against the engine. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of the vector+keyword fusion query (RRF) rather than just plain BM25 search.
